prompt: Your team is handing off a 2-year-old internal tool called `metrics-dashboard` to a different department. Stack: Python/Flask backend, React frontend, PostgreSQL, deployed on Kubernetes via Helm. About 200 daily users across product, ops, and finance teams. The receiving team has 3 mid-level engineers and 1 ops person; they have never seen this codebase. Produce the handoff documentation package. Save every file to the CURRENT directory. Do not ask clarifying questions. Print the list of files at the end.
assertions: At least one documentation file contains BOTH a '## Before You Begin' section (with a prerequisite list or checklist) AND a '## What You Will Learn' section (with bulleted learning outcomes). Both sections must appear in the same file. A file with only one of the two does NOT satisfy this — both are required for a Tutorial per the skill's Phase 3 specification.

A documentation plan, handoff plan, or index file contains explicit P0/P1/P2 priority markers — the literal strings 'P0', 'P1', or 'P2' must appear as priority labels in a table or section heading. Timing-based language like 'Read First: Yes' or 'Week 1' does NOT satisfy this — the P0/P1/P2 scheme is required.

At least one documentation file contains the comment '<!-- Doc-Type: Tutorial -->' as a line in the file AND that same file has a '## Before You Begin' section. The Doc-Type label and the required tutorial section must co-occur in the same file — a label without the section, or a section without the label, does NOT satisfy this.
